description: Database.OpenRecordset over T or "SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY ID" with these (type, options): (T, 16), (SQL, 16), (SQL dynaset 2, forward-only option 256), (SQL snapshot 4, 256), (SQL forward-only 8, 256), (T table 1, read-only option 4), (SQL snapshot 4, append-only option 8), (SQL dynaset 2, 12), (SQL dynaset 2, 48 = Inconsistent plus Consistent); a temporary QueryDef over the SQL with OpenRecordset type 16 and type 2 with option 256; a dynaset's own OpenRecordset with type 16. Each success reads Type, Updatable, Bookmarkable, Restartable and RecordCount and the ID of the first row, then closes. Asks which type and option combinations are accepted, the recordset kind they give, and the refusals. The pass-through (64) and async (1024) options are not used. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
